Meaning: Actual engine initialization callback plus isolated Ultimate Doom save-state music selection and IWAD/catalog identity checks. Optional finale case sends the emitted looping Bunny event into the actual qualified music playback reader and records its real-mix output. Optional map cases record the exact emitted track and catalog/qualification hashes; they do not prove campaign completion.
